How it works

Five steps from window to done.

You can do the whole transaction by email or WhatsApp, from your home or office.

Step 1 · Option A

I'll measure → extra 10% off

Take your own measurements and send them to us. Get a free quote, and an extra 10% discount as your reward for saving.

Our "How to measure" guide shows you exactly how.
Step 1 · Option B

Please measure for me

We come to you. There is a cash call-out fee of R300, paid to the consultant and refunded when you place your order.

R300 within 30 km of Pinetown; R400 for 30–60 km; R500 for 60–90 km.
  1. 1

    Measure

    Yourself for the extra 10% off, or with our measuring visit.

  2. 2

    Quote

    Send your requirements by form, email or WhatsApp. Your quote comes by email within 3 hours.

  3. 3

    Deposit

    Accept the quote, which becomes your official order, then pay the deposit.

  4. 4

    Verify

    Once your deposit is in, a representative visits to verify the measurements.

  5. 5

    Install

    We deliver to your doorstep, or install at your home or office.

Good to know: every blind is custom-made, so we don't accept returns. Delivery: we can deliver from the factory to anywhere in South Africa, and send samples on request.
Cleaning & repairs

Tired blinds? We clean and fix them.

We clean and repair Vertical, Venetian and Roller blinds in Durban and the surrounding areas. For a repair quote, send a photo on WhatsApp with your details and what's wrong.

Cleaning can't be done on-site, but some repairs can. Bring your blinds to us, or we remove and rehang them for you.

From R150per blind to clean, depending on width and blind type
R400pick-up & rehang, within 60 km of Pinetown (R500 for 60–100 km)
Send a photo on WhatsApp
Why Blind Specialist
1995

A family business that started by cleaning blinds.

Founded in 1995 on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices. It started with cleaning and repairing blinds and grew into selling custom-made blinds as an agent for top manufacturers.

Guarantee

3-year carry-in guarantee

All blinds undergo a double quality check. Found a factory fault? Send us a photo and we'll tell you whether it's repaired at the factory or on-site by a technician (within 50 km of our offices).

Top agents

Backed by the manufacturers

We are top agents for these manufacturers, and all blinds sold fall under their full guarantees, administered by us.

  • Ambient
  • Focus
  • Quantum
  • Coulisse
  • Blindquip
Happy customers

Phone them yourself

We've done blinds for companies, including the University of Zululand and Air Products Pinetown. You're welcome to phone them for a reference.
